$comment: EX-4401 single-screw pipe extruder twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the maker's data, the commissioning test and the resin data; the device sends only what it measures.

identification.model: KME 75-36 B/R single-screw extruder (75 mm, 36 L/D, grooved feed, barrier screw)
identification.description: Main extruder of a PE 100 pressure pipe line (pipe up to 250 mm)
identification.screw: Barrier screw, 75 mm, 36 L/D, in a bimetal cylinder with a deep-nitrided grooved feed bush
identification.drive: Synchronous AC motor with variable-speed drive, gearbox with the screw thrust bearing
identification.melt_path: Continuous screen changer, adapter, spiral mandrel pipe head

machine.source: KraussMaffei PO pipe brochure (EXT_BR_PO_pipe_en.pdf), technical data 36 L/D: screw diameter, L/D, 5/5 heating/cooling zones, maximum outputs for HDPE and PP, extrusion height.

conveying.source: Output rises linearly with screw speed, independent of counter-pressure (KraussMaffei PO pipe brochure (EXT_BR_PO_pipe_en.pdf), technical data 36 L/D, speed/throughput chart). Specific rate at commissioning and maximum screw speed: assumption: typical value, replace with the value from your machine's order documents or commissioning test. 5.5 kg/h per rpm x 125 rpm = 687 kg/h, inside the published 640-700 kg/h.

drive.source: Motor rating, no-load power, drive energy per kg at the reference resin, effect of the resin's melt flow rate on it, motor and drive efficiency: assumption: typical value, replace with the value from your machine's order documents or commissioning test.

heating.source: Barrel set temperatures for PE 100, heater power per zone (three bands in delta on 400 V), total heater power at the set output once the screw makes most of the heat: assumption: typical value, replace with the value from your machine's order documents or commissioning test.

material.name: PE 100 pipe compound
material.source: Reference melt flow rate (ISO 1133-1, 190 °C / 5 kg) of a PE 100 pipe grade, mean specific heat from 25 °C to the melt, heat of fusion of ~70 % crystalline PE, melt density and melt specific heat: assumption: typical value, replace with the value from your machine's order documents or commissioning test (use your resin data sheet).

rheology.source: Pressure before the pipe head and across a clean screen pack at the reference output, melt temperature and resin; power-law index n; pressure falls about 1.4 % per K (Arrhenius flow activation energy ~27 kJ/mol at 215 °C): assumption: typical value, replace with the value from your machine's order documents or commissioning test.

melt.source: Melt temperature at the die at the reference screw speed with a clean screen, and its rise per rpm, from the commissioning test: assumption: typical value, replace with the value from your machine's order documents or commissioning test. The adiabatic rise across the screen, dp / (rho x cp), is added by the twin.

wear.source: New flight clearance = diameter / 1000 per side (Spalding and Womer, Plastics Technology 2023); replacement rule of thumb at 4 x the original clearance (Surley, Plastics Technology 2018). Leakage model: loss of specific rate = k x ((clearance / new)^3 - 1) x head pressure / design pressure, with k so that 4 x the clearance costs about 15 % of the output per rpm: assumption: typical value, replace with the value from your machine's order documents or commissioning test (calibrate on your screw).

thrust.source: Thrust force = pressure at the screw tip x screw cross-section; ISO 281 basic rating life of a roller bearing L10 = (C/P)^(10/3) million revolutions. Design pressure and speed for the bearing's rated life: assumption: typical value, replace with the value from your machine's order documents or commissioning test.

gearbox.source: Oil temperature rise above ambient per kW of shaft power: assumption: typical value, replace with the value from your machine's order documents or commissioning test. Vibration limits: typical zone boundaries B/C and C/D for a 15-300 kW machine on a rigid foundation (ISO 20816-3, assumption: take the values for your machine group).

demo.note: The line holds 600 kg/h; screw speed follows the line's weight control. The clock of day plays no part.

points.label: Melt pressure at the screw tip, before the screen
Melt pressure after the screen, before the pipe head
Melt temperature at the pipe head
Melt flow rate of the resin lot (certificate)

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

screw_barrel_wear.name: Screw and barrel wear (flight clearance)
screw_barrel_wear.symptoms: output per rpm falls, the line raises the screw speed to hold the rate, melt hotter than expected

screen_pack_clogging.name: Screen pack clogging
screen_pack_clogging.symptoms: pressure drop across the screen grows, head pressure and thrust load rise

heater_band_failure.name: Heater band failure (one band of zone 3 open)
heater_band_failure.symptoms: zone current while on drops to two thirds; the zone may still hold its set point

feed_bush_cooling_loss.name: Grooved feed bush cooling loss
feed_bush_cooling_loss.symptoms: feed bush warms, the grooves lose their grip, output per rpm falls

gearbox_bearing_damage.name: Gearbox / thrust bearing damage
gearbox_bearing_damage.symptoms: vibration rises, oil warmer than the load explains

die_restriction.name: Pipe head restriction (contamination, degraded melt, cold die)
die_restriction.symptoms: pressure before the head above what output, resin and melt temperature explain

barrel_cooling_stuck.name: Barrel cooling blower stuck on (heaters fight the fans)
barrel_cooling_stuck.symptoms: heater power up, specific energy up, zones still at set point
